title: Normalized signed pullback families and scalar squares
statement: For sites, commutative ring sheaves and a ringed-site pullback $F$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], use the signed powers and scalar normalizations of [def-pur-signed-line-scalar-normalization-data]. Given $p:F(P)\cong P\prime$ and $T_d:F(P^{[d]})\cong(P\prime)^{[d]}$, SignedLinePullbackNormalized means that $T_0$ is the unit map, $T_1=p$, positive powers satisfy the canonical tensor recursion, and negative powers satisfy the evaluation equation on all pulled local functional/section pairs. Given compatible coefficient maps $\alpha:R\to S$, $\beta:R\prime\to S\prime$, structural maps, and degree-one scalar and pullback module isomorphisms, SignedLineScalarPullbackSquare is equality of the two composites under the canonical scalar/pullback reassociation. It is tested on every local scalar-extension generator inserted into the pullback by the actual adjunction unit. These are predicates only; no flatness, invertibility of coefficient maps or existence of normalized isomorphisms is asserted.
